notes_for_editor: Thin record. The Firelookout.ca record gives no build year, tower type, coordinates or status. A search snippet for a Firelookout.ca Facebook post reads 'Built 1969. Unsure of status', but the post fetched only its title, so 1969 is not in the story and needs checking by a human. The websiteservice.ca list is informal and its layout is hard to read. The five 'Iron' rows put the station directly under the name, but Bradford Iron's row misspells it 'Canoe ake' and Beaver Iron's reads 'Canoe lake'. The two Durocher rows put dates between the name and the station, and each has 'went to aerial detection' after it. The story names the station as Canoe Lake and does not repeat the misspelling. The address 'Canoe Lake 165' has the form of a First Nation reserve number. No source says so, so access is left unset; check before setting access. The brief's status and access stay unknown. The websiteservice.ca page also says after mid-August 2001 'all towers condemmed, to be rebuilt', but that note sits under another towermen's entry and does not name Canoe Lake, so it is not used. Word count is under the about-120 target because the sources are thin.
